text:
mara: heads-up: us-east1 apiserver watch latency + controller-manager reconcile backlog started ~09:12. saw etcd snapshot replay on 3 nodes during a maintenance window, GPU provisioning stalled for a few minutes. tagging eng-sre

ravi: looking into it, tailing etcd logs now. suspicious burst of snapshot replays and slow disk i/o metrics

olga: can you paste the etcd output snippets? /cc jamie for GPU allocator impact

mara: pasted snippet: ```
etcdserver: replayed snapshot index=459032 duration=2m12s
etcdserver: compacted lastIndex=459100
kube-apiserver: watchHandler took 5.2s for 1s window
```

jamie: confirmed GPU allocator saw reconcile P95s hit ~7m and many requests queued; autoscaler held off new allocations, so some pods stayed Pending ~4-6m :grimacing:

ravi: checking node iostats and disk latency - etcd nodes had sustained write latency spike at 09:10-09:15, correlates with snapshot replay windows

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-112 by mara

olga: checked peering/edge, no full outage but a transient BGP update around 09:11 that affected one aggregation router for ~45s — might have amplified retransmits to storage backend

mara: mitigation we applied: cordoned the noisy etcd host from the snapshot job, increased watch backoff on a couple apiserver frontends, and restarted controller-manager to flush huge reconcile queue

jamie: result: watch latency dropped back to normal within ~5m after restarts; GPU provisioning resumed and reserved pools cleared. deploy-bot: controller-manager revert rollout applied by jamie at 09:28

ravi: follow-up actions proposed: add an alert for etcd snapshot replay duration > 60s, iops-driven alert on the etcd volume, and a controller-manager reconcile P95 SLI to runbook. Also add a short checklist for GPU allocator stall detection

olga: taking the alerts, will open PR for thresholds and a runbook section. assigning to #oncall next rotation to validate

mara: filing a short postmortem and linking grafana panels: <https://grafana.redwood.local/d/apiserver-watch/apiserver-watch-latency?from=now-1h&to=now> :eyes:

jamie: also looking into tuning snapshot compaction schedule; may spread compactions across hours to avoid overlap with reserved-pool heavy windows

mara: thanks everyone, closing the thread for now. will ping when PM is posted
